title: fix(app-shell): the Studio landing and the console guide name an environment overlay, not an org overlay (objectui#12171)
body:
Fixes #12171
Clause-②: no

## What changes

ADR-0131 D6 (objectstack `main`, the sentence "ADR-0005's per-organization overlay axis is retired") leaves one overlay axis: the environment. The registry flag is `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, "may an environment overlay this packaged item" (objectstack#22340 S2). The Studio home still offered an "org overlay", and the permission matrix's hint on a packaged set still said "per-org overlay". Both now name the environment overlay, and so does the console guide.

Round 2 follows the claim amendment `6117050593`, which added `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` to this card.

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: the values of three landing keys, in both tables, en and zh. ⛔ No key is added or removed.
  - `engine.studio.landing.description`: "… customize them with an environment overlay." / 「…并用环境覆盖进行定制。」
  - `engine.studio.landing.readonlyHint`: "Customize one with an environment overlay, for the metadata types that accept one." / 「对于接受环境覆盖的元数据类型，可用环境覆盖（overlay）进行定制。」
  - `engine.studio.landing.overlayTitle`: "… each type shows whether it accepts an environment overlay" / 「…是否接受环境覆盖」
  - Each sentence keeps its structure; only the noun changes ("org overlay" to "environment overlay", 「组织覆盖」 to 「环境覆盖」).
- Same file: `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint`, the hint `PermissionMatrixEditor` shows on a set a code package ships. Only its parenthetical changes, in both languages:
  - en: "(ADR-0005 forbids per-org overlay of a packaged set: silent privilege drift)" becomes "(ADR-0131 D6 forbids an environment overlay of a packaged set: silent privilege drift)".
  - zh: 「（ADR-0005 禁止对已打包权限集做按组织覆盖：会造成权限静默漂移）」 becomes 「（ADR-0131 D6 禁止对已打包权限集做环境覆盖：会造成权限静默漂移）」.
  - **Why ADR-0131 D6 and not ADR-0005:** read on objectstack `main` (`018b077fb`), D6 restates the prohibition.
    - "No door edits a managed definition."
    - The overlay regime is limited to "the five presentational types".
    - Its customer-needs table answers "define their own roles" with "managed sets read-only, clonable".
    - The rationale "silent privilege drift" is ADR-0005's security row ("Authorization correctness; overlays would create silent privilege drift"). D6 keeps that environment layer "exactly as today, with the per-organization axis retired".
- Comments only, not user-visible: the note above the en `readonlyHint` in `i18n.ts`, and four doc comments in `BuilderLanding.tsx`, now say "environment overlay" (the amendment allows them).
- `content/docs/guide/console.md`, row "Read-only Packages in Studio": "Whether an item can take an environment overlay is decided per metadata type (`allowEnvironmentOverlay`)". Only that noun phrase changes.
- A pin, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.environmentOverlayCopy-12171.test.ts`, and the changeset `.changeset/12171-environment-overlay-copy.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

Which items an overlay can reach is not touched here; that is objectui#12169's question.

## Where the three keys live (measured on `main` `2498a07`)

- **Only in the designer's module-local table.** That is `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN` / `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH` in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, and its one reader is `views/studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`.
- **Not in the ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs.** Outside that table and its reader, `git grep` for the three key names hits two comments (one in the en pack, one in an i18n test) and no value.
- **So "every pack that carries the three keys" means two tables:** the en and zh tables this module declares. Its `SupportedLocale` union is `'en-US' | 'zh-CN'`, and the module header records that the other eight shipped locales render English on these screens. The `@object-ui/i18n` packs are unchanged.

## The pin

Triage asked for "a test that no shipped pack value for the three keys names the organization axis", read "from the packs, not from a hand list of locales".

- **Population:** every string table the designer module declares, narrowed to the tables that carry these keys.
  - They are read through `readDesignerPairs`, the extractor `check:i18n-designer-parity` reads with.
  - No list of locales is kept, so a table added for another language joins by itself.
- **Keys:** the three landing keys, and since round 2 `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint`.
- **Pin:** no value of these keys, in any table that carries them, names the organization axis ("org", "per-org", "organization", 组织).
- **Lit control on the matcher:** every one of those values names the environment overlay ("environment overlay", 环境覆盖).
  - A table in a language neither pattern speaks fails here, so the pin cannot pass by matching nothing.
  - The hint's new parenthetical says "environment overlay" / 环境覆盖, so this one control fits all four keys.
- **Lit control on the reader:** for every locale in the module's own `SupportedLocale` union, the value `t()` serves is the one the extractor read. The union is held complete by a `satisfies` record, so a new locale fails the type-check until it is listed.

**Ablation.** Each leg starts from a committed state and goes through `ablation-replace.mjs`, objectstack's helper: the anchor must hit once, and both the blob change and the restore are checked on disk.
- Each leg was restored: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Legs A and B ran on `2092f35` (HEAD blob `532458febc45`); leg C ran on `02a16f9` (HEAD blob `2029d216292e`).

| Leg | Mutation | Expected | Observed |
|---|---|---|---|
| B (isolates the pin) | en `readonlyHint` names both axes: "an environment overlay or an org overlay" | pin red, matcher control green | 1 of 3 tests failed, 2 passed; the offender is `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN engine.studio.landing.readonlyHint` |
| A (one value reverted) | zh `overlayTitle` back to 「组织覆盖」 | pin red and matcher control red | 2 of 3 tests failed, 1 passed; both name `ENGINE_STRINGS_ZH engine.studio.landing.overlayTitle` |
| C (the added key reverted) | en hint parenthetical back to "(ADR-0005 forbids per-org overlay of a packaged set:" | pin red and matcher control red | 2 of 3 tests failed, 1 passed; both name `ENGINE_STRINGS_EN perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` |

## Verification, on `02a16f9`

`02a16f9` is the final commit. The branch merged `main` `83b9fad` first.

- **Build:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, through the verify lock: `Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (the script echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Tests:** targeted vitest, through the lock, gave `Test Files 26 passed (26)`, `Tests 153 passed (153)`.
  - It covered the pin, all 20 `PermissionMatrixEditor.*` suites, the four `BuilderLanding.*` suites and `apps/console` `StudioRoute.landingI18n.test.tsx`.
- **No existing test asserts the hint's old parenthetical.**
  - The `PermissionMatrixEditor` suites pin other parts of it (`Clone to customize`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, `not_overridable`, the `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` sentence), and all of them stay.
  - The one "per-org" string in those tests is a mocked server sentence in `PermissionMatrixEditor.cloneToCustomize.test.tsx`, not this hint.
- **i18n checks:**
  - `pnpm check:i18n-drift`: 4 en values changed, 0 keys added, 0 removed, and 4 zh values followed, then "Every changed designer-table en value was followed by its zh row." Exit 0.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`: "Every en row has a zh row, and every shared row carries the same placeholders." Exit 0.
  - `pnpm check:i18n-keys` and `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only): exit 0.
- **Docs:** `pnpm docs:check-links`: exit 0. `pnpm check:doc-fences` exited 0 in round 1, and the guide is unchanged since.
- **Changesets:** exit 0 on all four.
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "3 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
  - `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: "No pending changeset names a file this change touches."
  - `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`.
- **Other repo checks:** `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)") and `pnpm check:test-path-roots`: exit 0.
- **ESLint, narrowed and proven:** `--format json` reports 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - The config lints `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, so the population this diff adds to is its three TypeScript files.
  - The config sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, and no local rule reads a file from disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Governed check:** `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the five paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

Found while measuring. Not changed here.

1. **Taken into this card in round 2:** `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` (amendment `6117050593`), see above.
2. **The pending changeset `.changeset/11808-readonly-package-card.md` keeps its "org overlay" / `allowOrgOverride` wording.** The amendment keeps it as history, the way objectui#12141's claim treated pending changesets that name the old key. `.changeset/12141-allow-environment-overlay.md` carries the rename in the same release.
3. **Comments in objectui#12169's files still say "per-org overlay" / "ORG OVERLAY".** These are `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `PageShell.tsx`, `ResourceEditPage.resetVerdict.test.tsx` and the `PermissionMatrixEditor` tests. The header of `PermissionMatrixEditor.readonly.test.tsx` quotes the hint's old parenthetical in a comment. None of it is user-visible, and that card's dev held those files this round.
4. **On objectstack `main` (`018b077fb`) the registry still spells the flag `allowOrgOverride`.** `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` has no `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, and the permission entry is `allowOrgOverride: false`. objectui#12141's changeset already says to run this release against a server carrying objectstack#22340 S2. Noted, not a finding of this card.
